design_condition: The volume is stretched between the access route and football pitches near the existing school, but creates an unconvincing leftover area and little western distance from the neighbouring building.

positive.statement: The entry fits well into the existing structure through its horizontal stratification and moderate height development.

position.rationale: Long horizontal mass and moderate elevations support the stated scale judgment.

positive.statement: The school and special rooms are well proportioned, daylit, and accessed through spacious anterooms.

position.rationale: Rooms are not individually visible; anchor samples the layered central region.

negative.statement: The remaining area between the new building and the street is unconvincing, while the western open space provides little distance from the existing building.

position.target: street-side remaining area and western open space
position.rationale: Anchor marks a lateral perimeter area; surrounding site is not explicitly modeled.

negative.statement: The outdoor spaces are represented schematically and do not suggest an overarching design idea.

position.rationale: Anchor marks an exterior edge beside the elongated volume.

negative.statement: The generous view of the gymnasium from the entrance is questionable and not attractive enough.

position.rationale: Approximate low end-zone relationship; gymnasium and entrance are not separable.

negative.statement: The internal organization is schematic and complicated, producing functional deficiencies and difficult access to the teacher area.

position.target: internal organization and teacher area access
position.rationale: Internal circulation is not visible; placement represents the plan-wide issue.

negative.statement: The gymnasium cloakrooms and showers are inconveniently arranged for operational reasons.

position.rationale: Service rooms are not distinguishable; anchor approximates a low end zone.

negative.statement: The double gymnasium has only indirect natural lighting.

position.rationale: Gymnasium is not uniquely visible; anchor samples a broad central-height volume.

negative.statement: The response to summer heat protection does not appear sufficient.

position.rationale: Heat protection concerns exposed upper envelope surfaces.
